sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of pirtobrutinib during breastfeeding. Because it is 96% bound to plasma proteins, concentrations in milk are likely to be low. The manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be discontinued during pirtobrutinib therapy and for 1 week after the last dose.
